proposed_skill_yaml:
skill: obstacle_reach
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: goal_proximity
  metric: goal_progress
- id: obstacle_clearance
  anchor: fixture
  weight: 0.5
phases:
- id: arc_over_obstacle
  type: approach
  generator: arc_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: none
  parameters:
    arc_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.15
      - 0.5
      default: 0.3
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.arc_height
        mode: replace
    reach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
    reach_tolerance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.03
      default: 0.02
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.pose_tolerance
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: contact_guard
    when: during_phase
    predicate: contact_detected
    threshold: 5.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: goal_proximity
- id: descend_to_goal
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: none
  parameters:
    descend_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.05
      default: 0.02
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
    descend_tolerance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.005
      - 0.02
      default: 0.01
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.pose_tolerance
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: contact_guard_descend
    when: during_phase
    predicate: contact_detected
    threshold: 5.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:
    max_attempts: 1
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - -0.05
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: goal_proximity
